scene.ofreeRecent: a small repair kiosk with a cluttered workbench — carries a camera by its grip at her side; an outdoor thermal swimming terrace inside an old volcanic quarry — she laughs softly when a sudden bubble plume pops beside her; the upper balcony of a wooden pavilion with upturned eaves — standing at a waist-high railing or sill; a quiet saltwater floatation spa beside a large round window — she tests the salinity by floating a tiny empty transparent bowl on the water and watches it bob with an amused half-smile; an open-air miniature railway station platform with an empty bench — she sits on her small suitcase eating a roasted sweet potato wrapped in plain paper; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — lying on her left side; her bedroom — holds a cup at chest height; a glass greenhouse full of plants with a wooden potting bench — kneeling on the ground; a Korean jjimjilbang hall with heated floors and sleeping mats — standing; a narrow path through a tall bamboo grove — standing; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing; an open-air hot spring among steaming rocks — works a soft mesh bath puff into a rich lather between her hands; a traditional archery ground beside a temple wall — standing close to a high shelf or line
